line: If my shooter keep missin’, I bench him
vault_lines: If my shooter keep missin', I bench him
meaning:
Polo uses sport analogy to say how he’d bench his shooter on a drill if they keep missing.

Benching players is used in a variety of sports, mainly for playing time, injuries or slacking performance. In his case, slacking performance is missing in a shootout.

vault_lines: Drac' got a rubber grip, on Cap, I'll heat this bitch up like a furnace
meaning: Capo real name Marvin Carr, was a Chicago rapper affiliated with Chief Keef’s Glory Boyz Entertainment (GBE), also known as Glo Gang. line: That nigga survivin’ nines, I bet he gon’ die, he get hit with this big-ass ten
vault_lines: That nigga survivin' nines, I bet he gon' die, he get hit with this big-ass ten (You know that)
meaning:
Von is saying that if someone is able to survive gunshots from a 9mm firearm, he will use 10mm ammunition the next time.

10mm ammunition is vastly superior to 9mm in terms of size and muzzle velocity.
